physicalNotes: Radius 1.619 Jupiter radii from Lendl et al. 2020 (2020A&A...643A..94L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...643A..94L/abstract): 115,745.5 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 1.99 Jupiter masses (Lendl et al. 2020, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2020A&A...643A..94L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...643A..94L/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
